crossRefs.note: but when the flock were feeble, he didn’t put them in. So the feebler were Laban’s, and the stronger Jacob’s.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Laban
people.line: Brother of Rebekah; father of Leah and Rachel

translations.web: but when the flock were feeble, he didn’t put them in. So the feebler were Laban’s, and the stronger Jacob’s.
translations.bsb: But if the animals were weak, he did not set out the branches. So the weaker animals went to Laban and the stronger ones to Jacob.
translations.kjv: But when the cattle were feeble, he put them not in: so the feebler were Laban's, and the stronger Jacob's.
translations.asv: but when the flock were feeble, he put them not in: so the feebler were Laban's, and the stronger Jacob's.
